name: Stretch
source:
A visual novel about disconnected youth drifting through the edges of society —
an atmospheric journey wrapped in the quiet air of “those days that never quite happened.”

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3762460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于漂流在社会边缘的失联青年的视觉小说——
一场充满气氛的旅程，包裹在“那些从未真正发生过的日子”的安静空气中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3762460/]Steam[/url]]
